KeyView.description: A key, as the API shows it: never its secret.

expires_at.description: When it stops working, if it was given an end.

id.description: Its id, the part of the key after `exk_` and before the secret.

last_used_at.description: When it was last used, to the minute. None if it never was.

name.description: What it's for, such as "Claude Code on the desktop".

revoked_at.description: When it was revoked, if it was.

scopes.description: What it may be used for, as far as its person's role allows.

Scope.description: What a key may be used for.

oneOf.description:
Read jobs, runs, definitions, Harness² and metrics, and call tools
that only read.
Chat, through MCP or the front door, and mark a run good or bad.
Start workflow runs, and call tools that change something.
Start Harness² attempts, revert its changes and hold agents.

description: A page of keys, oldest first.

has_more.description: True if there are more past this page.
